$comments: OElite .NET appsettings.init.json template — integration-profile pattern (Issue #97, Marcus's final spec). See 1_dotNet_coding_standards/17-LOCAL-DEV-PEER-INTEGRATION.md and CONFIGURATION-VALIDATION.md. Secrets NEVER live in this file — they load from the OS credential store (SECURITY-PATTERNS.md).

integration.$comment.defaultProfile: Level 4 of the resolution order (per-peer env var > per-peer appsettings > OELITE_PROFILE > this > platform default 'local-peers'). Legal values ONLY: 'mock-peers' | 'local-peers' | 'uat-peers'. There is no 'prod' value — the resolver rejects anything else at startup, fail-fast.

peers.$comment.enabled: Master switch for peer integration in this app. false = resolver skips peer endpoint resolution entirely (hermetic apps, CLI tools).
peers.$comment.requiredOnStartup: true = startup FAILS FAST if any resolved peer fails the peers-health pre-flight. false = loud warning + startup continues (note: this is a warning, NOT a mock/local fallback — Emma's stakeholder decision #1 on #97 rejected degraded mode). Peers flagged 'critical: true' in the registry hard-fail regardless of this setting.
peers.$comment.timeoutSeconds: Per-peer connectivity/health timeout in seconds, passed to peers-health checks. 30s is the platform default.
peers.$comment.credentialsMode: Per-peer credential acquisition mode (V2, TASK-99). 'static' (platform default): credentials load from the OS credential store per SECURITY-PATTERNS.md § 2-3, on the 90-day rotation SLA. 'dynamic': short-lived UAT tokens are minted at startup via the Origin Auth client-credentials flow using the per-developer 'dev-<username>-local' IAM client (BR-DEV-005), TTL <= 15 min, refreshed at 80% of TTL, cached under 'oelite/peer/<peerName>/uat-token' — see 1_dotNet_coding_standards/18-DYNAMIC-PEER-CREDENTIALS.md. Mode is declared per-peer in the central registry (peer-registry.yml 'credentials.mode'); apps do NOT set this value locally — the resolver reads the registry and fails fast on unknown values.

integration.$comment.perPeerOverrides: Optional per-peer overrides — level 2 of the resolution order. Each key is a registry peer name (camelCase, e.g. originAuth, nexus, obelisk). 'profile' must again be one of the three legal values; 'iamClient' is required when profile is 'uat-peers' and must be a per-developer client named dev-<username>-local (BR-DEV-005) — never the shared UAT acceptance client. Example below is commented out in the template; uncomment and edit per app.

originAuth.$comment: Example per-peer override — remove this comment block and set real values only when opting this peer into UAT.
